text:
Lena (Product Designer): dropping a quick proposal for an 'approval lanes' layout focused on quick triage. Key ideas: compact run rows, an inline diff peek (+/- icon) that expands without leaving scorecard, and a bulk-move modal with optional example preview. figma: https://redwood.mock/f/approve-lanes-v1
Gabe (PM): really like the inline diff peek. Q: when users open the peek, do we mark the run as 'viewed'? we want to avoid accidental stale state.
Lena (Product Designer): good call. proposal: only mark viewed when the user clicks 'mark viewed' or tabs out of the expanded pane. we'll show a subtle 'viewed' dot otherwise.
Marta (Frontend Eng): implementation notes: inline diffs must be keyboard-expandable and we should avoid mounting heavy diff libs on initial page load. lazy-mount on first expand. Also bulk-move modal should stream progress for each run.
Theo (Accessibility): a11y checklist: (1) expand button needs aria-expanded and aria-controls (2) inline diff container should set aria-live polite for content changes so SR users notice (3) if we mark viewed automatically, announce 'Run X marked viewed' via aria-live. Also color contrast on the +/- icon needs tweaks.
Ravi (Research): from usability sessions, reviewers want a 1-line summary above the diff and a one-click 'copy failing example' action. They also asked for 'why moved' quick reasons in the bulk modal (dropdown: flaky, spam, low-quality, needs-edit).
Gabe (PM): product decision needed: default reason when none chosen? and undo window. proposal: default to 'needs-followup' with no reason, undo available for 24 hours via a visible activity log and an undo snackbar.
Lena (Product Designer): copy options for the modal primary CTA: 'Move runs', 'Move to Follow-up', 'Confirm move'. prefer 'Move to Follow-up' for clarity. Small secondary action: 'Add note'.
Marta (Frontend Eng): technical: API shape suggestion to support streaming progress: POST /runs/bulk_move returns job id; GET /runs/bulk_move/{job_id}/events streams events like 'moved-run-id' and 'failed-run-id'. Frontend can render per-row spinner until event received.
Theo (Accessibility): addendum: snackbar should use role=alert to surface undo, and undo should be keyboard reachable. After undo, focus should return to the run row that was the primary context.
Ravi (Research): UX test hypothesis: inline diff peek will reduce context-switches by >30% for reviewers. we'll run a small A/B with 20 reviewers. Need telemetry: count expands, copies, and moves from expand state.
Gabe (PM): legal/retention note: if users add override reasons, these must persist in audit logs for 90 days per compliance. tagging eng-security after sync.
Lena (Product Designer): accessibility microcopy suggestions: for expand button use 'Show diff for run {id}', tooltip for +/-: 'Open inline regression diff'. We'll make icons accessible and add focus rings.
Marta (Frontend Eng): one more edge: bulk move across multiple pages. If user selects 200 runs across pages, modal needs to confirm the selection count and chunk moves to avoid server timeouts. We'll also show estimated time.
Gabe (PM): UX copy for confirmation when large bulk: 'You're about to move 200 runs to Follow-up. This may take a few minutes. Continue?'
Theo (Accessibility): ensure the confirmation is a modal with aria-modal true and focus trapped. Also provide an accessible summary for screenreaders that includes the count.
Lena (Product Designer): thanks all. I'll update the mock with: (1) expand-first load lazy mount (2) inline copy button (3) bulk modal with collapsed preview and reason dropdown (4) undo snackbar with 24h revert.
